##: The Cordango command line, as a Scoop manifest.
THIS FILE BELONGS IN `cordango/scoop-bucket`, at `bucket/cordango.json`. It is kept here so
the canonical copy sits beside the workflow that produces the assets it points at.
`checkver` and `autoupdate` mean it maintains itself: the bucket's own scheduled job asks
GitHub for the latest release, rewrites the version and the two hashes, and commits. A
manifest updated by hand is a manifest that is a release behind, and that is worse than
having no channel — somebody installs it and reports a bug that was fixed a month ago.
The hashes below are zeros on purpose: they are of files that do not exist until the
release is built. `release.yml` runs `packaging/render.sh` over the real SHA256SUMS and
attaches the finished manifest to the release, and the bucket's job rewrites them anyway.
No dependency on .NET. The binary is self-contained and carries its own runtime.
